annotations.title: Check a token name/ticker before launch or purchase

description: Run the impersonation detector on a token name and/or ticker symbol without needing an address. Tells you whether a coin called e.g. "SpaceX Official" ($SPACEX) or "TSLAx" would be flagged as impersonating a brand, which brand, and why. Use for pre-launch name checks, or when a user mentions a coin by name and you have no address (with an address, use check_token). Does not assess creator behaviour.
name: check_name
title: Check a token name/ticker before launch or purchase
